2608.08623.title: MedCalc-R1: Knowledge-Guided Reward Framework for Medical Mathematical Reasoning
2608.08623.paper_summary: In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) frameworks for mathematical reasoning tasks, floating-point results are typically evaluated using a tolerance-based reward. However, this strategy suffers from challenges such as difficulty in threshold calibration, unstable training dynamics, and limited accuracy, especially in clinical scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose a knowledge-guided hybrid reward framework (\textsc{MedCalc-R1}). Specifically, we introduce a knowledge verification reward mechanism that enforces explicit generation of computational formulas, which are further validated by an external verifier to enhance interpretability and reasoning reliability. Furthermore, we design a hybrid soft-hard reward scheme combining a hard constraint based on clinical safety thresholds with a soft, precision-sensitive reward that progressively guides learning within the acceptable range. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines in both reasoning accuracy and generalization capability, validating the effectiveness and applicability in safety-critical domains.
2608.08623.paper_summary_zh: 在用於數學推理任務的可驗證獎勵強化學習（RLVR）框架中，浮點結果通常使用基於容忍度的獎勵進行評估。<lb/>然而，這一策略面臨著一些挑戰，例如閾值校準困難、訓練動態不穩定以及準確性有限，尤其是在臨床場景中。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一個知識引導的混合獎勵框架（\textsc{MedCalc-R1}）。<lb/>具體而言，我們引入了一種知識驗證獎勵機制，強制明確生成計算公式，這些公式進一步由外部驗證者進行驗證，以增強可解釋性和推理可靠性。<lb/>此外，我們設計了一種混合軟硬獎勵方案，將基於臨床安全閾值的硬約束與一種逐步引導學習的軟性、精確度敏感的獎勵相結合。<lb/>實驗結果表明，我們的方法在推理準確性和泛化能力方面顯著優於現有基準，驗證了其在安全關鍵領域的有效性和適用性。
